## Owner decisions (2026-11-01)

| Gap | Decision |
|---|---|
| 2 · three eligible candidates | Approved by the addendum itself (§9: "use deterministic synthetic technicians, organizations, shifts, coverage territories, support contracts and service histories"). The expired-certificate and wrong-site technicians stay as stress cases next to the new pool. |
| 3 · overrides | **Preferences only.** Hard gates (skills, licences, safety, site access, tenant) can never be overridden. A ranking preference can be overridden with a mandatory written reason and an audit record. Reassignment stays in scope, with a reason, and only to eligible people. |
| 4 · credential wording | **"Internal competency"**, a synthetic record with a verification state: declared, lab-evidenced, or verified by a reviewer. Nothing reads "certified". |
| 8 · geography | **Add fictional sites**: a few deterministic, clearly fictional sites in other cities and regions, so coverage maps and territories are real fixture data. |
| 10 · task #338 | The rules are in the owner's #338 directive (six-step workflow; Affected / Demonstrably unaffected / Unknown; automatic dependency expansion; an incomplete graph means review, never silent; mandatory tests are never waived by review; unknown waivability counts as non-waivable). ServiceHands routes out-of-rule equipment changes to a pending change, as #338 is not authorized for implementation. |
| 11 · language and time zone | **Yes, declared only.** A declared requirement is matched against a declared capability and treated as a preference. Neither is ever inferred from a name or location. |
| 12 · travel | Omitted: there is no authorized routing source (addendum §2). |
| 6 · communications | Everything stays a draft or a labelled simulation (addendum §1). Legacy `mailto:`/`tel:` navigation is not recovered. |
| 1, 5, 7, 9, 13 | Still open; the defaults in this document hold until the owner decides. |
EOF
